artifact:
Statechart Test Suite for U20_Embedded Controller

Statechart:
1. Initial State
2. Pressure Fall Phase
3. Pressure Control Phase
4. FiO2 Control Phase
5. Assist/Control Mode
6. Safety Mode

Events:
- Pressure Command
- FiO2 Command
- Inspiration Detection
- Data Corruption
- Mode Switch

Guards:
- Pressure Fall Phase Overshoot
- Pressure Control Phase Accuracy
- FiO2 Accuracy
- Air Condition Variation
- Assist/Control Mode Activation
- Safety Mode Activation

Lifecycle:
- Start
- Transition to Pressure Fall Phase
- Transition to Pressure Control Phase
- Transition to FiO2 Control Phase
- Transition to Assist/Control Mode
- Transition to Safety Mode
- End

Mode-Switching Behaviour:
- From Initial to Pressure Fall Phase
- From Pressure Fall Phase to Pressure Control Phase
- From Pressure Control Phase to FiO2 Control Phase
- From FiO2 Control Phase to Assist/Control Mode
- From Assist/Control Mode to Safety Mode
- From Safety Mode to End

Test Cases:

TC-001:
{
  "id": "TC-001",
  "title": "Pressure Fall Phase Overshoot",
  "req_ids": ["RW-SW-63"],
  "kind": "positive",
  "preconditions": ["Controller in Pressure Control Phase"],
  "inputs": {"name": "Pressure Command"},
  "steps": ["Detect Pressure Command", "Measure Pressure Fall Phase Overshoot"],
  "expected": ["Pressure Fall Phase Overshoot <= 0.8*PEEP-1 cmH2O"]
}

TC-002:
{
  "id": "TC-002",
  "title": "Pressure Control Phase Accuracy",
  "req_ids": ["RW-SW-64"],
  "kind": "positive",
  "preconditions": ["Controller in Pressure Control Phase"],
  "inputs": {"name": "Pressure Command"},
  "steps": ["Detect Pressure Command", "Measure Pressure Control Phase Accuracy"],
  "expected": ["Pressure Control Phase Accuracy <= +-1 H2O + 10%"]
}

TC-003:
{
  "id": "TC-003",
  "title": "FiO2 Accuracy",
  "req_ids": ["RW-SW-95"],
  "kind": "positive",
  "preconditions": ["Controller in FiO2 Control Phase"],
  "inputs": {"name": "FiO2 Command"},
  "steps": ["Detect FiO2 Command", "Measure FiO2 Accuracy"],
  "expected": ["FiO2 Accuracy <= 0.05"]
}

TC-004:
{
  "id": "TC-004",
  "title": "Air Condition Variation",
  "req_ids": ["RW-SW-98"],
  "kind": "positive",
  "preconditions": ["Controller in FiO2 Control Phase"],
  "inputs": {"name": "FiO2 Command"},
  "steps": ["Detect FiO2 Command", "Measure Air Condition Variation"],
  "expected": ["Air Condition Variation does not affect FiO2 Accuracy"]
}

TC-005:
{
  "id": "TC-005",
  "title": "Assist/Control Mode Activation",
  "req_ids": ["RW-SW-153"],
  "kind": "positive",
  "preconditions": ["Controller in Assist/Control Mode"],
  "inputs": {"name": "Inspiration Detection"},
  "steps": ["Detect Inspiration", "Activate Assist/Control Mode"],
  "expected": ["Assist/Control Mode Activated"]
}

TC-006:
{
  "id": "TC-006",
  "title": "Safety Mode Activation",
  "req_ids": ["RW-SW-156"],
  "kind": "positive",
  "preconditions": ["Controller in Safety Mode"],
  "inputs": {"name": "Data Corruption"},
  "steps": ["Detect Data Corruption", "Activate Safety Mode"],
  "expected": ["Safety Mode Activated"]
}

TC-007:
{
  "id": "TC-007",
  "title": "Report FiO2 Prior to Inhale",
  "req_ids": ["RW-SW-97"],
  "kind": "positive",
  "preconditions": ["Controller in FiO2 Control Phase"],
  "inputs": {"name": "FiO2 Command"},
  "steps": ["Detect FiO2 Command", "Report FiO2 Prior to Inhale"],
  "expected": ["FiO2 Prior to Inhale is reported"]
}

TC-008:
{
  "id": "TC-008",
  "title": "Commanded Pressure Meeting",
  "req_ids": ["RW-SW-63", "RW-SW-64"],
  "kind": "positive",
  "preconditions": ["Controller in Pressure Control Phase"],
  "inputs": {"name": "Pressure Command"},
  "steps": ["Detect Pressure Command", "Measure Pressure Meeting"],
  "expected": ["Pressure Meeting <= 0.8*PEEP-1 cmH2O", "Pressure Meeting >= -1 H2O + 10%"]
}

TC-009:
{
  "id": "TC-009",
  "title": "Commanded FiO2 Meeting",
  "req_ids": ["RW-SW-95", "RW-SW-98"],
  "kind": "positive",
  "preconditions": ["Controller in FiO2 Control Phase"],
  "inputs": {"name": "FiO2 Command"},
  "steps": ["Detect FiO2 Command", "Measure FiO2 Meeting"],
  "expected": ["FiO2 Meeting <= 0.05", "FiO2 Meeting is not affected by Air Condition Variation"]
}

TC-010:
{
  "id": "TC-010",
  "title": "Assist/Control Mode Meeting",
  "req_ids": ["RW-SW-153"],
  "kind": "positive",
  "preconditions": ["Controller in Assist/Control Mode"],
  "inputs": {"name": "Inspiration Detection"},
  "steps": ["Detect Inspiration", "Measure Assist/Control Mode Meeting"],
  "expected": ["Assist/Control Mode Meeting is triggered by Inspiration Detection"]
}

TC-011:
{
  "id": "TC-011",
  "title": "Safety Mode Meeting",
  "req_ids": ["RW-SW-156"],
  "kind": "positive",
  "preconditions": ["Controller in Safety Mode"],
  "inputs": {"name": "Data Corruption"},
  "steps": ["Detect Data Corruption", "Measure Safety Mode Meeting"],
  "expected": ["Safety Mode Meeting is triggered by Data Corruption"]
}
}
